name: EMSA
reference:
import torch
import math
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(queries, keys, values, n_heads, height, width, ratio, apply_transform):
    torch.manual_seed(42)
    if queries.shape[1] != height * width:
        raise ValueError('height * width must match the sequence length')
    B, S, D = queries.shape
    head_dim = D // n_heads
    q_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=queries.device, dtype=queries.dtype)
    k_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=queries.device, dtype=queries.dtype)
    v_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=queries.device, dtype=queries.dtype)
    out_proj = nn.Linear(D, D, bias=False).to(device=queries.device, dtype=queries.dtype)
    kernel_size = ratio + 1
    pad = ratio // 2
    reduce_k = nn.Conv2d(D, D, kernel_size, stride=ratio, padding=pad, groups=D, bias=False).to(device=queries.device, dtype=queries.dtype)
    reduce_v = nn.Conv2d(D, D, kernel_size, stride=ratio, padding=pad, groups=D, bias=False).to(device=queries.device, dtype=queries.dtype)
    norm_k = nn.LayerNorm(D).to(device=queries.device, dtype=queries.dtype)
    norm_v = nn.LayerNorm(D).to(device=queries.device, dtype=queries.dtype)
    transform = None
    if apply_transform and n_heads > 1:
        transform = nn.Conv2d(n_heads, n_heads, 1, bias=False).to(device=queries.device, dtype=queries.dtype)

    q = q_proj(queries).view(B, S, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    keys_2d = keys.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, height, width)
    values_2d = values.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, height, width)
    reduced_k = norm_k(reduce_k(keys_2d).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2))
    reduced_v = norm_v(reduce_v(values_2d).flatten(2).transpose(1, 2))
    reduced_sequence = reduced_k.shape[1]
    k = k_proj(reduced_k).view(B, reduced_sequence, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    v = v_proj(reduced_v).view(B, reduced_sequence, n_heads, head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
    scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)
    if transform is not None:
        scores = transform(scores)
    weights = F.softmax(scores.float(), dim=-1)
    output = torch.matmul(weights, v.float()).to(dtype=queries.dtype)
    output = output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, S, D)
    return out_proj(output)
description: Efficient Multi-head Self-Attention with spatial reduction via depthwise convolutions.
